contract.intent: Human interface + Renderers (S8) — presents step cards + artifacts at the human gates (GATE1 grilling, GATE2 confirm-result); collects accept/reject + feedback (the talk-loop, F7); talk v1 with web HTML via the same adapter (web UI = target surface); tree view, step cards, full plan renders (F10/F11/F12). Refuses to skip a gate, fabricate an acceptance, or invent feedback; never renders scalar progress (AC5) or secrets.
acceptanceCriteria: Gate talk-loop (F7): present card to collect decision to collect feedback
Adapter: talk v1; the same interface serves web HTML (target surface, swappable)
Renders: tree view (F10), step cards (F11), full plan (F12)
No scalar progress (AC5); no secrets rendered
